name: Hydrogen
teaser: The first light in the universe, born from pure energy in the first moments of creation.

name: Helium
teaser: Fused from hydrogen in the cosmic furnace, the second element to grace existence.

name: Lithium
teaser: Traced back to the Big Bang itself, rare and ancient, a relic of the universe's first moments.

name: Carbon
teaser: The backbone of life, forged in the hearts of aging stars and scattered across the cosmos.

name: Nitrogen
teaser: Born in stellar furnaces, it breathes life into every living thing on Earth.

name: Oxygen
teaser: Forged in the nuclear hearts of dying stars, it fuels the spark of consciousness itself.

name: Magnesium
teaser: Created in the final throes of a stellar collapse, this metal once burned in an alien sun.

name: Silicon
teaser: The architect of worlds, forged in massive stars and now the foundation of planets and sand.

name: Sulfur
teaser: Born in the violent cores of dying giants, it traveled across space to become part of you.

name: Iron
teaser: Forged in the final breath of a giant star, this element once beat at the heart of worlds.

name: Platinum
teaser: Born only in cosmic collisions and neutron star mergers, the rarest gift from the universe.

name: Gold
teaser: Created in the violent collision of neutron stars, this precious metal carries the universe's most extreme moment.

name: Uranium
teaser: Born in the violent death throes of massive stars, its radioactive pulse echoes across billions of years.
